tool_args.rationale: The target horizon is much longer than the observed pilot window, and competing mechanisms predict different long-horizon behavior. The slow-horizon probe directly addresses this identifiability ambiguity.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the dual-exponential adaptation model to the pilot alone
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The five short-horizon observations do not reliably identify the slow timescale or the response at H = 21.1.
The pilot has s_grad = 0 and cannot identify the sink effect; the slow-horizon probe is the specified discriminator.
The short pilot does not distinguish it adequately from adaptation at the target horizon.
More fine short-horizon measurements are less directly informative about the long-horizon reversal.
